historical_basis: Emily Zarka's original PBS Monstrum educational program Banshee: Ireland's Screaming Harbinger of Death (25 Sept 2019), transcript directly states some banshees have crow shapeshifting ability in its Irish tradition discussion. Uses that rare animal variant with current creature's herald-of-death research, not making every banshee avian or identifying the spirit as Badb herself. Donald Mackenzie separately records raven/hoodie-crow in Scottish named Banshee traditions; this corroboration is regional and not conflated with universal Irish identity.
